description: A high-contrast poster built like a wanted bill turned inside-out — not WANTED but WANTED BACK. A gunfighter stands centred and unhurried against a white noon, coat open, hands empty and loose, because the poster wants you to understand he doesn't need to reach. ALPHAGUNMAN NEVER FIRED FIRST. HE NEVER HAD TO FIRE SECOND EITHER. The paper is punched clean through by a single old bullet hole, dead centre, which someone has helpfully circled and labelled "exhibit A."
name: hero poster: ALPHAGUNMAN, THE LAST STRAIGHT SHOOTER
